tasks.title: Overshoot from the damping ratio
tasks.statement: A second-order system with ζ = **{z}**. Find the step-response overshoot (%).
tasks.solution: Overshoot = exp(−π·ζ/√(1−ζ²)). ζ ≈ 0.7 gives about 5 %, the target for the rate loop; 0.3 already gives 37 %, ringing.

tasks.title: Settling time
tasks.statement: ζ = **{z}**, natural frequency ωₙ = **{w} rad/s**. Estimate the settling time (s, 2 % criterion).
tasks.solution: t_s ≈ 4/(ζ·ωₙ): the envelope decays as exp(−ζωₙt) and reaches 2 % within four time constants.
